### Repligen Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Updates Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance


Oct 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/906585988/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/Repligen-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Updates-Full-Year-2026-Financial-Guidance.pdf)


- *Third quarter revenue of $209 million, a year-over-year increase of 11% as reported and 12.5% organic*
- *Closed BioLife acquisition, which fast-tracks Repligen’s leadership and offering in high-growth cell therapy market*
- *Raising FY26 revenue guidance to $844-$852 million which represents reported revenue growth of 14.5% - 15.5%*


WALTHAM, Mass., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN), today reported financial results for its third quarter of 2026, covering the three-month period ended September 30, 2026. The Company is also providing updated financial guidance for the full year 2026.


Olivier Loeillot, President and Chief Executive Officer of Repligen said, “We delivered a record third quarter, with $209 million in revenue and 12.5% organic growth, driven by continued strength across our diversified portfolio. End-market demand continues to improve, with healthy trends in consumables and services complemented by a growing capital equipment order book.”


Mr. Loeillot continued, “The completion of the BioLife acquisition in October marks a significant milestone for Repligen, and integration is progressing well. Early customer feedback has been very encouraging, and we have already taken actions to realize a sizable portion of our expected operating expense synergies. Our strong year-to-date performance, continued order momentum and the addition of BioLife give us confidence to raise our full-year guidance again.”


**BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS**


- **Completed Acquisition of BioLife Solutions.** The acquisition strengthens Repligen's position in cell therapy by adding a differentiated, deeply embedded consumables platform with recurring revenue, commercial-stage exposure, and strong customer workflow integration. The combination expands Repligen's portfolio and is expected to enhance the Company's long-term growth, margin profile, and earnings power.
- **New Repligen Training & Innovation Center (“RTIC”).** On October 23, 2026, opened a new RTIC in Seoul, South Korea. This underscores Repligen’s commitment to a strategically important market that has become one of the world’s leading hubs for biologics and CDMO manufacturing.


**FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE**


Q3 2026 Financial Performance (compared to prior year periods except as noted)


*All adjusted figures are non-GAAP and, except for earnings per share (“EPS”), are rounded to the nearest million, and are reconciled in the tables included later in this press release.*


- Q3 reported revenue was $209.3 million, compared to $188.8 million, an increase of 11% as reported and 12.5% organic.
- **GAAP Results.** Q3 loss from operations was $29.5 million primarily driven by intangible asset impairment charge, compared to income from operations of $16.8 million. Q3 loss per share was $0.68 on a fully diluted basis, compared to EPS of $0.26.
- **Adjusted Results.** Q3 adjusted income from operations was $33.3 million, compared to $26.8 million. Q3 adjusted EPS was $0.53 on a fully diluted basis, compared to $0.46.

**About Repligen Corporation**


Repligen Corporation is a global bioprocessing company that develops and commercializes innovative technologies and integrated solutions that support critical steps in the manufacturing and delivery of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. As a trusted partner to biopharmaceutical developers and manufacturers and CDMOs worldwide, we help improve productivity, simplify complex workflows, and advance the next generation of biologic therapies. Repligen technologies support the production of a broad range of biologic modalities, helping customers navigate evolving manufacturing challenges from process development through commercial production. Our global team combines deep scientific expertise, innovation, and a customer-focused mindset “inspiring advances in bioprocessing” to help solve complex challenges across biologics manufacturing. For more information, please visit our website at[https://www.repligen.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hbarkiqXlZWL8Fcp4n59B6Izj6t4dh0apB8-r1JbWt8JX1bTx02qD_xMBDHAyVsft2y0T2gLJBZsTCXuqc3bUMNWwSoqYBVg2PIkFDQrqM8=) , and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yoRNsnbUKF283lqqOZMu9Ron-iM1tKuLo1H0ID3o-RGJ_vJWnyayzv3mz4PLjRf5Raw_WSzrD8ISrcoXN4vuUwhgkHPQSdwqlD4gP8PSoZ2uwO4PoebUbtvIBBsEFcew) .


**Non-GAAP Measures of Financial Performance**


To supplement our financial statements, which are presented on the basis of U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”), the following Adjusted (“non-GAAP”) measures of financial performance are included in this release: organic revenue and organic revenue growth; adjusted gross profit and adjusted gross margin; adjusted income from operations and adjusted operating margin; organic adjusted operating margin year-over-year change; adjusted net income and adjusted net income margin; adjusted earnings per share (diluted); adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), and adjusted EBITDA margin. The Company provides the impact of foreign currency translation, to enable determination of revenue and margin growth rates at constant currency. To calculate the impact of foreign currency translation, the Company converts the reported amounts from local currency to U.S. dollars using constant foreign currency exchange rates in the current and prior year periods.


The Company’s non-GAAP financial results and/or non-GAAP guidance exclude the impact of: acquisition, integration and divestiture costs; restructuring charges including the costs of severance and accelerated depreciation among other non-cash charges; inventory step-up costs and adjustments; transformation costs including incremental, non-recurring expenses for discrete strategic projects that are designed to deliver long-term benefits, including improvements to enhance productivity and enable company growth that do not meet the definition of restructuring; contingent consideration related to the Company’s acquisitions; intangible amortization costs; intangible asset impairment charges; non-cash interest expense related to the accretion of the debt discount; amortization of debt issuance costs related to Company’s convertible debt; foreign currency impact of certain intercompany loans; loss on sale of business; and, the related impact on tax of non-GAAP charges.


These costs are excluded because management believes that such expenses do not have a direct correlation to future business operations, nor do the resulting charges recorded accurately reflect the performance of our ongoing operations for the period in which such charges are recorded. Additionally, for a project to be considered transformational, the project expenses are expected to bring long-term growth, profitability improvements and defined process and technology improvements. Our transformation initiative is multi-year but each project has a discrete, defined timeline. Further, organic adjusted operating margin year-over-year change excludes the effect of adjustments above, as well as the impact of mergers, acquisitions and divestitures and foreign exchange. This measure is used by the Company in periods of acquisition because the timing, size and number of such transactions and their related impact on the financial statements may vary and make comparison of long-term results difficult.


All reconciliations of above GAAP figures to adjusted (non-GAAP) figures are detailed in the tables included later in this press release. Certain prior year amounts have been reclassified to conform with the current year presentation. When analyzing the Company’s operating performance and guidance, investors should not consider non-GAAP measures as a substitute for the comparable financial measures prepared in accordance with GAAP.


The Company does not provide GAAP financial measures on a forward-looking basis as the Company is unable to provide a quantitative reconciliation of forward-looking non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable forward-looking GAAP measure, without unreasonable effort. The Company cannot reasonably predict items including, but not limited to, the timing and amount of future restructuring and cost-savings actions or transformation, acquisition and integration related costs. These items are generally uncertain and are not indicative of ongoing operations of the business, and the impact could be material to our results in accordance with GAAP.
